blocks.title: Waterfall lifecycle
blocks.text: Sequential analysis, design, implementation, testing and maintenance.

blocks.title: Agile methods
blocks.text: Iterative delivery, feedback and reprioritisation in short cycles.

blocks.title: Choose on evidence
blocks.text: Stability, regulation, stakeholder access and change risk affect suitability.

blocks.title: Worked example · Model answer
blocks.text: A plan-driven/waterfall approach can support documented phase gates and traceability; however, testing and validation must still occur throughout as appropriate. Safety assurance matters more than simply labelling it waterfall. Check: link each claim to the scenario and use precise OCR terminology.

questions.feedback: agile — Iterative and adaptive development principles.
iteration — Repeated short cycle yielding feedback/increment.

blocks.title: What must we decide?
blocks.text: Identify the inputs, relevant facts and exact output or judgement required.

blocks.title: Work through the method
blocks.text: Use the middle stage of the visual to follow the process and state each intermediate result.

blocks.title: Shared worked answer
blocks.text: Agile iterations with prioritised backlog, frequent releases and real user feedback. A strictly sequential plan risks discovering changed needs late. Maintain security and test discipline.
